name: Hoffa Fat Pad Impingement
definition: Painful irritation or impingement of the infrapatellar fat pad, usually producing anterior knee pain around terminal extension.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is mainly clinical; MRI is used when diagnosis is uncertain or other pathology is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Injection or arthroscopy is selective for refractory cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu soft-tissue pain phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful irritation or impingement of the infrapatellar fat pad, usually producing anterior knee pain around terminal extension.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
